responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s Punycode encoding utility used to turn Unicode text into ASCII-only labels. The header exposes encode_punycode over Utf8String with tl::optional failure reporting and declares the associated selftest entry point, forming the public interface for code that needs RFC 3492-compatible name encoding without the xn-- prefix handling layer.
same_name_distinction: Header half of the rust-punycode pair: it declares the public encode_punycode interface over Utf8String and the selftest hook, while rust-punycode.cc contains the actual Punycode conversion machinery and test cases.
